description: Reconciliation of 16 historical P2 semantic variant pairs into 32 distinct capabilities preserving both authentic V1 and alternative V2.

pairs.v1_solution: Calibrated historical route distribution analysis providing justified BUY, MONITOR, or WAIT signals with uncertainty boundaries.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Never displays definitive BUY recommendation when sample size < 10 or price variance is uncalibrated.
pairs.v2_solution: Multi-day stay length duration matrix optimizing cheapest return date offset based on observed departure cohorts.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Matrix accurately identifies price inflection points across stay durations of 3 to 14 days.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F36-V1 (Buy/Wait Guidance) and F36-V2 (Trip-Length Optimizer).

pairs.v1_solution: Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) robust outlier detection distinguishing genuine price drops from data glitches.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Zero fares, negative prices, and 10x spikes flagged as SUSPECTED_DATA_GLITCH; drops require MAD >= 2.5 and sample >= 10.
pairs.v2_solution: Automated Thursday-to-Sunday or Friday-to-Monday weekend getaway finder across all monitored domestic/regional destinations.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Correctly binds weekend calendar windows to observed flight schedules without false availability.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F37-V1 (Price Anomaly Detection) and F37-V2 (Weekend Escape Finder).

pairs.v1_solution: Historical lunar calendar and statutory holiday price surge pattern analysis indicating peak multiplier horizons.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Forecasts Tet surge window with historical baseline dates and confidence intervals.
pairs.v2_solution: Comprehensive national holiday calendar grid mapping public holidays to observed route pricing tiers.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Maps public holidays for Vietnam and ASEAN destinations with accurate date offsets.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F38-V1 (Holiday Surge Calendar) and F38-V2 (Holiday Calendar Matrix).

pairs.v1_solution: Multi-airport catchment area price comparison evaluating total transit cost/time trade-offs.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Displays alternative departures within 150km with ground transport estimates.
pairs.v2_solution: Mathematical optimization of airfare delta vs secondary ground transit expense and duration.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Flags nearby airport only if net savings exceed estimated ground transfer cost.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F39-V1 (Nearby Airport Comparison) and F39-V2 (Nearby Airport Economics).

pairs.v1_solution: Deterministic airline-specific ancillary fee model calculating true all-in checkout price.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Itemizes seat selection, baggage tiers, and payment processing fees with breakdown.
pairs.v2_solution: Multi-factor composite scoring layover duration, red-eye flights, self-transfer risks, and airline punctuality.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Calculates 0-100 quality score penalizing self-transfers and layovers > 8 hours.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F40-V1 (Hidden Fee Estimator) and F40-V2 (Itinerary Quality Score).

pairs.v1_solution: Grounded natural language generation explaining why a deal is exceptional using cohort evidence.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Explanations cite exact percentile and historical baseline; never hallucinate unverified savings.
pairs.v2_solution: Rule-based structured evidence cards breaking down discount drivers, seasonality, and risk indicators.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Renders standardized reason chips backed by mathematical cohort comparison.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F41-V1 (AI Deal Narrative) and F41-V2 (Consumer Opportunity Explanation).

pairs.v1_solution: Adaptive alert dispatch frequency based on deal quality, user interaction, and price change velocity.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Limits non-critical alerts to maximum 1 per 24 hours per route unless price drops > 15%.
pairs.v2_solution: State-machine tracking alert episode lifecycles (ENTERED, IMPROVED, EXITED, REENTERED) preventing notification spam.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Suppresses alerts within same episode unless price improves by at least the configured threshold.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F42-V1 (Smart Alert Frequency) and F42-V2 (Intelligent Watch Episode Management).

pairs.v1_solution: Consolidated weekly summary of top opportunities matching user watchlists and saved routes.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Dispatches scheduled weekly digest respecting unsubscribe and notification preferences.
pairs.v2_solution: Aggregated multi-route report grouping verified deals by destination region and departure month.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Generates structured multi-destination opportunity digest from active generations.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F43-V1 (Weekly Deal Digest) and F43-V2 (Consolidated Opportunity Digest).

pairs.v1_solution: Collaborative filtering and interest-based ranking personalizing the deal feed per user.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Ranks user-preferred origins and destinations higher without hiding exceptional universal deals.
pairs.v2_solution: Deterministic preference matching prioritizing explicit user travel parameters and budgets.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Filters and sorts feed according to explicit user settings with zero opaque ML bias.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F44-V1 (Personalized Deal Feed) and F44-V2 (Rule-Based Personalized Feed).

pairs.v1_solution: Dynamic Open Graph and social media card image generation highlighting deal price and savings.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Generates valid 1200x630 OG preview cards with exact deal details and brand attribution.
pairs.v2_solution: Permanent shareable URLs for individual opportunities with real-time freshness and expiry status.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Public links resolve to live opportunity or display clear EXPIRED notice with alternative deals.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F45-V1 (Social Shareable Cards) and F45-V2 (Public Opportunity URLs).

pairs.v1_solution: Editorially maintained collections (e.g., Summer Beach Getaways, Visa-Free Escapes) grouping related routes.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Collections display curated thematic deals with active validation against current generation.
pairs.v2_solution: Algorithmic collections dynamically populated based on tag taxonomies and pricing anomalies.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Auto-updates collections when new qualified deals enter the active generation.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F46-V1 (Curated Editorial Collections) and F46-V2 (Dynamic Editorial Collections).

pairs.v1_solution: Simultaneous multi-source price cross-verification comparing GDS, OTA, and direct airline pricing.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Cross-checks at least 2 independent provider sources before labeling a deal as VERIFIED_LOWEST.
pairs.v2_solution: Empirical scoring of provider price accuracy based on downstream verification success rates.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Downweights providers with price mismatch rates > 15% in RouteBest selection.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F47-V1 (Multi-Provider Cross-Check) and F47-V2 (Provider Trust Metric).

pairs.v1_solution: Interactive historical price lookup allowing users to query past fare distributions for any route.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Renders 30/60/90-day price distribution percentile charts on demand.
pairs.v2_solution: Dynamic crawler scheduling increasing scan frequency for volatile or high-demand routes.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Allocates scan quota proportionally to route volatility and user watch density.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F48-V1 (Historical Price Search) and F48-V2 (Adaptive Scan Priority).

pairs.v1_solution: Multi-leg flight routing engine detecting open-jaw and complex itinerary opportunities.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Correctly prices and links multi-city itineraries without leg decoupling errors.
pairs.v2_solution: Specialized graph-based open-jaw route generator optimizing multi-city surface sectors.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Identifies cheaper open-jaw alternatives where overland transit saves > 25% total airfare.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F86-V1 (Multi-City & Open-Jaw) and F86-V2 (Open-Jaw Routing Architecture).

pairs.v1_solution: Multi-passenger fare bucket tiering analyzer optimizing split bookings across fare classes.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Flags when booking 4 passengers as 2+2 saves money due to single-seat fare bucket boundaries.
pairs.v2_solution: Multi-user shared trip planning workspace with voting and split payment coordination.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Enables multiple authenticated users to vote on candidate opportunities.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F87-V1 (Group Booking Optimization) and F87-V2 (Collaborative Group Planning).

pairs.v1_solution: Timely visa and travel readiness status indicators bound to destination airports and citizen passports.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Displays accurate visa-free duration, e-visa requirements, and passport validity rules.
pairs.v2_solution: Real-time entry regulation and border advisory alert stream updating travel requirements.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Flags travel advisory changes within 24 hours of official government publication.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F88-V1 (Visa & Entry Integration) and F88-V2 (Travel Readiness Feed).
